p: Enso is our frontier family, and the router that picks among every model on the gateway when you ask for auto. A vendor’s published score and your own are rarely the same number, so every row below was run here, ours and theirs on the same questions, and each one links its run.

Ultra, Pro and Flash. A preset is a pool and a rate, not another name for one model; the band is what you are billed, input then output, per million tokens. The runs below measure the router itself, not a preset.
